claims.claim: **Yes, AI coding assistants can reduce software-development task completion time.
claims.source_sentence: **Yes, AI coding assistants can reduce software-development task completion time, but the effect is not universal.** Randomized studies show substantial time savings in some settings and a measurable slowdown in another.

claims.claim: The effect is not universal.** Randomized studies show substantial time savings in some settings and a measurable slowdown in another.

claims.claim: | **Becker et al., METR (2025):** 16 experienced open-source developers completed 246 real tasks in repositories they knew well.
